Thanks — quick internal note so we all have the same expectation:

- Finance can issue a provisional PO (PO-210458-provisional) that allows SRE to start capacity reservation work, provided Mosaic uploads the corrected W-8BEN-E and notarized affidavit within 72 hours of the provisional PO date.
- If the notarized affidavit is delayed beyond 72 hours, the provisional PO will be void and any work will be paused until final docs are received.
- Once final docs are uploaded and verified, Procurement will lift the provisional status and create the hard PO (PO-210458).

Jonas — can you confirm Mosaic is okay with the provisional terms in your next outreach?
